verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no public REST or developer API for Superhuman Mail, and probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs at standard paths all returned 404. The product does ship an official MCP server that lets Claude or ChatGPT drive the inbox, but that is a separate MCP-server capability. It is not a documented public API, so it does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
